description:
The written report on one portfolio, with every figure numbered F1, F2... beside the
        method and the window behind it. For a reader who wants something to quote or
        keep; measure_portfolio returns this same report together with structure,
        look-through and crises.
        Amounts make the report speak in money, in the base currency (default USD).
        The window starts when the youngest holding starts, and the report says so.

base.description: Currency every figure is expressed in (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD…). Default USD.
base.title: Base

holdings.description: What is held: {ticker: weight or amount}. Weights need not sum to one; amounts in the base currency are also accepted (then the crises are shown in money). 1 to 100 holdings. Tickers as the exchange lists them (VOO, VWCE.DE, XAW.TO; 'CASH.USD' for cash).
holdings.title: Holdings

name: portfolio_report

outputSchema.description: The numbered report: every figure beside its method.

_fence.description: What these figures are and are not: descriptive, no forecast, no advice. Repeat its sense when presenting the result.

facts.description: One entry per figure: id, label, value, method, window, limit.

markdown.description: The report as markdown, figures numbered F1, F2…

receipt.description: A short plain-text receipt of the same figures.

title: The numbered report
